name: AEM-Driven Quality Improvement for Aristotle Mathematical Research

description: Exp 12: AEM 5-pillar prompt engineering for Aristotle. Enhanced all prompts Aristotle receives with AEM quality directives. Aristotle's direct prompt now includes full AEM QUALITY SCORING section with pillar-by-pillar guidelines. Enrichment prompts include AEM targets. Quality evaluator returns AEM pillar scores. Baseline catalog AEM: 27.86/50 (R=7.15 A=5.52 U=5.00 O=4.18 I=6.01).
